_provenance.note: Generated from ICP-1.0 §9 (SettlementReceipt) and the reference verifySettlementReceipt (packages/icp-client), requireSettler=true. Signatures are real Ed25519 over the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the unsigned receipt body, produced with fixed seeds (merchant 0x11*32, settler 0x22*32). Error precedence: field presence, then merchant signature, then settler signature.
